Name: Shammah, Son of Agee
Summary: Shammah, son of Agee the Hararite, was one of David's three mighty men. When the Philistines gathered at a field of lentiles and Israel fled, he stood in the middle of the field, defended it, and the Lord wrought a great victory.
KeyStory: Shammah held a lentil field alone against the Philistines — and God gave the victory.
RelatedPeople: King David; Eleazar, Son of Dodo; Agee, Father of Shammah
LifeLesson: Defending an ordinary field can be the greatest victory of a life.
